messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, volumes and proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price.

On volumes, our attached packages cover 4580 pcs per year over 24 or 36 months. This is a longer commitment than your 12-month quote and gives your plant a stable load. Following our annual review, where your team was open on payment terms, both packages move payment closer to our current 90-day agreement.

Could you also confirm the earliest lead time you can support for January call-offs, given your holiday shutdown?

Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, volumes and proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate the proposed 36-month contract duration, which provides mutual stability and allows us to offer a revised price of EUR 427.96.

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding your inquiry about January call-offs, our team will separately confirm the earliest lead times considering the holiday shutdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for accepting the 36-month term. We understand the constraint on price reductions mentioned at our annual review (doc:20260826-70530-M1), where your team was open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

The attached packages use that room. All three cover 4580 pcs per year over 36 months. Two of them move payment closer to the 90 days of our current agreement (ctr:4600070530), and those packages carry a higher unit price than the 30-day package.

Which of these packages could you make your primary standing offer? Could you also confirm the call-off date you need for January deliveries, given your holiday shutdown?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to accommodate your request for extended payment terms by offering 60 days net. As our price reductions remain frozen, this adjustment in payment terms brings the unit price to EUR 429.42. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €429.42 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Regarding your question about January deliveries, our logistics department will provide the necessary call-off dates separately. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Part 350020 frame agreement: revised package, 90 days, 36 months
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for meeting us on payment terms.

We have moved our attached package a real step toward your offer. It keeps the structure of your primary standing offer: 4580 pcs per year over 36 months, with 90 days net as in our current agreement (ctr:4600070530). The long term gives your plant a stable load for three years, and you keep the planning certainty of a fixed annual volume.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

We look forward to the January call-off dates from your logistics team.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Part 350020 frame agreement: revised package, 90 days, 36 months

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised proposal and the step towards our position. As our management has frozen all price reductions, EUR 430.88 remains our lowest possible price for the 36-month contract with 90 days payment. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our logistics department will provide the required January call-off dates separately.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Dear Sir or Madam,

We appreciate your readiness to sign the agreement today. As previously communicated, our management has strictly frozen all price reductions, making EUR 430.88 our absolute limit for the 36-month contract with 90 days payment. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We look forward to receiving your confirmation to conclude the renewal. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
